newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan banks lag behind in financial technology - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan banks lag behind in financial technology - MOF.

text.p: Japanese banks lag behind their overseas counterparts in financial technology, a senior Ministry of Finance (MOF) official said on Tuesday.
"Major (Japanese) banks have acquired overseas technology, but the world is much more ahead," Kimio Yamaguchi, director-general of the ministry's Banking Bureau told a parliamentary committee.
"In the field of financial technology, (Japanese banks) lag significantly behind," he added.
Yamaguchi also said that he has hopes that many Japanese banks will be able to withstand the "Big Bang" reforms of Tokyo's financial market.
But Yamaguchi added that the reforms were aimed at reinvigorating the Japanese market and not at protecting Japanese financial institutions.
